title: Admin member rosters can list members oldest signup first

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-11-17 (project thread): view admin users chronologically; owner chose adding an Oldest sort to the CRM sorts

detail: The Resonance CRM member roster (/admin/crm/members) and the Member Roster (/admin/members) both list newest signups first, and there was no way to read the list from the first signup forward. MEMBER_SORT_OPTIONS gains an Oldest option beside Recent, reading the same joined value (profiles.created_at) ascending. Every roster that shares the list (CRM members, the cockpit viewer, Contacts, Space and leader rosters) gets the button. sortMembers' ascending path is already pinned in lib/people/member-viewer.test.ts.

verify.note: Fails on main: MEMBER_SORT_OPTIONS has no Oldest option. Passes once an Oldest sort reads joined ascending beside Recent.
